Claude Code CLI: let it use GoatCitadel tools

Experimental and on by default. When on, Chat turns on the Claude Code CLI provider can ask for GoatCitadel tools. Turn it off to stop offering GoatCitadel tools to the Claude Code CLI.

Refresh

Current: On

Let the Claude Code CLI use GoatCitadel tools
Tools run in GoatCitadel, not inside Claude Code. Your permissions, tool grants and approvals still decide what may run.
Each tool step starts a new claude -p run with your own Claude sign-in, unless Claude Code CLI: reuse one process between tool steps is on and the step continues the previous one exactly. A turn that uses tools counts more against your Claude subscription.
Tools are not sandboxed by this setting. It is a GoatCitadel option, not an Anthropic feature.
Save setting
Claude Code CLI: reuse one process between tool steps

When a tool step continues the previous one exactly, keeps that turn's Claude Code process running instead of starting a new one; any other step still starts a new one. Tools still run in GoatCitadel. Experimental and
